output.summary: The SOW grants Buyer 100% ownership of all foreground work product per Section 9.1, satisfying the 'Work Made for Hire' requirement for custom deliverables. However, Section 9.3 restricts the background runtime license to non-transferable, non-sublicensable use by Buyer only, violating the constraint that the platform must be distributable and sublicensed to external enterprise clients as white-labeled software.
key_claims: All custom deliverables are 100% owned by Buyer per Section 9.1
Background runtime license is non-transferable and non-sublicensable per Section 9.3
Platform requires sublicensing to external clients per user goal
risks_or_flaws: License for background runtime is non-sublicensable, violating requirement to distribute/sub-license platform to external clients
output.verification_question: Does Section 9.3's 'non-sublicensable' restriction apply to the entire platform or only Buyer's internal use of the background runtime?
